mile.en: Microsoft, for example, signed a deal back in 2024 to bring one of the two reactors at Three Mile Island, in Pennsylvania, back to life.
mile.zh: 例如，微软在2024年签署了一项协议，让宾夕法尼亚州三哩岛的两座反应堆之一重获新生。

mile.en: As you may remember, Three Mile Island was the site of a famous partial meltdown back in 1979, but that happened in the other reactor .
mile.zh: 你可能还记得，三哩岛在1979年曾发生过一次著名的部分熔毁事故，但那是发生在另一座反应堆上。

mild.en: When people imagine traditional British food, they picture boiled vegetables with potatoes and gravy and mild flavors.
mild.zh: 当人们想象传统的英国食物时，他们脑海中浮现的是带土豆和肉汁的水煮蔬菜以及温和的风味。

microwave.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
microwave.zh: 战后几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食餐、微波炉食品。

mint.en: The UK grows lots of delicious herbs, mint and rosemary and thyme, we use a lot of that in our cooking.
mint.zh: 英国生长着许多美味的草本植物，薄荷、迷迭香和百里香，我们在烹饪中大量使用这些。
